newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says one-offs benefit Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says one-offs benefit Q2 results.

text.p: The Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd (BHP) managing director John Prescott said on Wednesday that one-off factors may go in favour of BHP's results in the current quarter.
"On balance I think the one-offs might go for us this time because last time they went against us," Prescott told reporters when asked about second quarter profits.
Prescott did not specify what one-offs would be present in the second quarter results.
He again said it was too early to make any forecast about the overall outcome in the second quarter.
He repeated comments made on Friday after BHP's first quarter result that the steel market remained difficult, but that efficiency gains would help the division.
"I don't expect copper prices to rebound, except temporarily for some time, so we're then critically dependent on getting the costs down," Prescott said.
